workflows.name: Compile an OEM map into user outputs
workflows.goal: Produce an organized user map and requested offline outputs in one resumable outcome run.
stop_conditions: one grouped source decision is required
a requested target needs device binding
a separate physical read or byte-order decision is required
write, broadcast, scan, credentials, or live polling requested

workflows.name: Review a register map
workflows.goal: Produce a validated Modbus map quickly without silent engineering guesses or serial approval loops.

steps.instruction: Skip this gate when the review status is ready. Otherwise resolve all independent exception groups in one batch with reasons and shared-scope evidence references; never ask page by page or row by row.

workflows.name: Determine byte order from supplied raw words
workflows.goal: Compare explicit layouts from one immutable raw sample and record human confirmation.

steps.instruction: Present eliminated candidates, the complete remaining shortlist, and distinguishing evidence in one decision. Confirm one explicit layout and keep the raw sample and all candidates.

workflows.name: Probe, resolve byte order, and finalize a tool pack
workflows.goal: Use a selected tool target to collect one raw sample, compare byte-order candidates, then regenerate all selected targets with the confirmed layout.

steps.instruction: Run one bounded read against the reviewed endpoint and save the returned raw 16-bit words. Do not scan or write.
Confirm the explicit layout and record the sample as evidence.

workflows.name: Build a multi-target tool pack
workflows.goal: Generate any selected combination of Node-RED, Modpoll, and ModScan from one validated map and one read plan.

workflows.name: Analyze bounded read data
workflows.goal: Find communication and signal-quality problems without issuing control commands.

steps.condition: a finding requires a consequential follow-up
steps.instruction: Present all threshold, metadata, and alternative-cause exceptions together before a consequential follow-up. Skip this gate for a report-only request.

workflows.name: Compare map revisions
workflows.goal: Report stable field changes without collapsing points from different routes, areas, or unit identifiers.

steps.condition: the user asks to accept or deploy the new revision
steps.instruction: Group moved, added, removed, and changed points by cause and request one acceptance decision only when acceptance or deployment is in scope.
